name: Masuo-san
source:
Main character is going to marry a girl from a known family. That family has a tradition that the week before the wedding groom has to live with the bride's family. A lot of unexpected events can happen in one week...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角要娶一位来自名门望族的女孩。那个家庭有一个传统，结婚前一周新郎必须和新娘的家人住在一起。一周之内可能会发生很多意想不到的事情……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
